scope: CPU-only inspection of two completed real native single-thalamus fits; NPZ/images remain remote
interpretation: The same synthetic geometry can be followed by substantially different intensity trajectories and final accuracy. The traced zero Wolfe steps have negative gtd and large accepted gradient norms, so they are not evidence of a stationary solution.
evaluation_status: C4 not selected: synthetic arrays and trajectories repeat exactly but the two complete fits have official weighted Dice 0.8852 and 0.9587; no four-structure benchmark started.
